newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to range-trade, upside at 110-22.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to range-trade, upside at 110-22.

text.p: June T-bond futures are set to remain stuck in a range between 108-30 and 110-22 on Wednesday, technical analysts said.
"I see a very limited chance of a breakout going into next week," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data in London.
Charts show 108-30 as the daily low on May 8, the lowest point so far this month. On the upside 110-22 resistance comes from rally highs on May 13.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a note that prices looked set to continue higher in the short-term.
But they also pegged significant resistance around the 110-18,22 level of recent highs and even before that at 110-12,13, saying the market was likely to remain rangebound for a while to come.
"We still expect range trading, broadly between 111 and 107 for another month or so (there can be some brief forays outside of there), before we begin the next major leg lower," they said.
By 1000 GMT, June T-bonds were 7/32 higher at 110-02.
DMG analysts said daily stochastics continued to edge lower, although downside momentum was flagging and they said they expected to see higher prices over the next few days.
On the downside Cossor said: "If we do break below 108-30, then we could easily see a bear move down to levels in mid-April, below 108-08, which wouldn't be too constructive."
But on the upside he said any push through last week's highs of 110-18,22 could lead to levels which had not been seen for months, with the 111-24,26 area looking cheap.
DMG analysts said a move to 111-00 handles was a pretty good bet. "We would start building shorts near there," they said.
By 1011 GMT, September Eurodollars were up 0.015 at 93.970.
